list.title: Online orders
list.text: Orders from the phone, Facebook and the website, from draft to delivered.
list.empty_text: Orders appear here as they are taken. Start with "New order".

new.title: New order
new.text: Who it is for, where it goes, how it is paid and what is in it.
new.find_item: Find an item by name or SKU, then press Enter
new.no_items: No items yet. Find one above and add it.
new.no_zones: No delivery areas are set in the rules; type the charge.
new.estimate: A guide: VAT and the final total are worked out when the order is saved.
new.saved: Order {number} saved as a draft. Confirm it to hold the stock.

done.confirm: Confirmed: the stock is held for this order.
done.ship: Sent out: the stock has left the warehouse.
done.deliver: Delivered and added to the books.
done.return: Order taken back: the goods are in stock again.

order.supervisor_note: A supervisor cancels orders already sent out and takes delivered orders back.
order.cancel_note: Cancelling lets the held stock go. Money paid is given back.
order.pay_text: {amount} is owed. Record what was received.
order.cancel_text: The order stops here. Stock sent out comes back to the warehouse.
order.return_text: The goods come back to the warehouse and their sale is reversed; the delivery charge stays owed.
